acceptance_criteria.criterion: publication remains trusted-parent-owned and exact-head validation remains authoritative
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Review authority stays trusted-parent-owned and exact-head bound. The governance lane checks out the default branch into `engine/` and executes only that copy; the candidate's own workflow file holds no permission that can drive another workflow, which `tests/test_hunter_review_orchestrator.py::test_no_pull_request_reachable_workflow_can_drive_other_workflows` enforces structurally against every trigger and permission shape. Privileged orchestration (`actions: write`) lives only in the reconcile workflow, which has no `pull_request` trigger. Authority is bound to the exact head throughout: `tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py::test_an_ancestor_recorded_head_is_stale_not_valid` and `tests/test_pr473_trusted_bridge_bootstrap.py::test_candidate_workspace_file_cannot_end_bootstrap_pending_mode`. Repaired and extended. The ordered-pool exhaustion contract this family owns is unchanged: reviewers are still attempted in strict priority order with both recorded budgets, a triage-only reviewer still never closes the pool, and the last-resort guard still requires the whole enabled pool to be exhausted with zero unresolved threads and green Governance and trusted Preflight. What this head adds is the missing transition out of exhaustion: exhaustion is now generation-scoped evidence rather than a permanent property of an immutable head, so a receipt minted under a superseded remediation generation is refused instead of replayed to justify a lower-priority authority. Regression evidence: tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py::test_exhaustion_receipt_from_a_prior_remediation_generation_is_not_reusable and tests/test_hunter_reviewer_collector.py::test_a_receipt_bound_to_the_current_remediation_generation_still_verifies.

This head establishes the family and repairs the defect it names. A remediation generation is a digest over the exact head, the claims digest and the set of resolved blocking review threads, where a thread counts only when an authenticated reviewer app that is neither Hunter's own automation nor the pull-request author opened it. The trusted default-branch orchestrator derives it where it decides to dispatch and the trusted collector re-derives it independently, failing closed when the dispatched generation is not the one the evidence supports. It enters the collector run name, the reviewer invocation key, both reviewer trigger bodies and the collector receipt, so an advanced generation buys exactly one new invocation per reviewer and an unchanged one buys none. It is bounded by a material change of generation, a finished previous collector, the absence of a collector for this generation, and MAX_REMEDIATION_GENERATIONS per exact head. Mechanical guard: scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py::validate_review_after_remediation_boundary, invoked from validate_defect_prevention_lifecycle in the Defect Prevention Guard at the push boundary, with paired negative fixtures in tests/test_review_after_remediation_generation.py for each way the binding could be removed. Regression evidence: the six targets DFF-024 declares in docs/DEFECT_REGISTRY.json.
